name: KEENON Robotics
summary:
KEENON Robotics develops service robots and integrated solutions for commercial environments. Founded in 2010, the company expanded from autonomous delivery into applications including guidance, disinfection and other service tasks. Its robots are used in settings such as restaurants, hotels, hospitals, retail venues and industrial facilities.

The business combines autonomous mobility with product forms designed for particular workflows. International offices and support operations help adapt deployments to different markets. KEENON's wider significance in robotics is its experience turning navigation and interaction capabilities into repeatable service products, with customer applications and operational integration forming a major part of its development work.
